en.headline: HKJC postpones Conghua racing debut; reports record HK$331.7 billion turnover
en.dek: The planned 31 October launch of regular racing at the Guangzhou track is delayed after a latest risk assessment from mainland departments; the Club also reported strong results for the year ended 30 June.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said on Wednesday that the planned launch of regular racing at Conghua Racecourse on 31 October has been postponed. The Club said it had worked closely with the relevant Mainland departments and completed the necessary statutory and procedural requirements, but had very recently received a latest risk assessment. Following discussions, both sides agreed to continue working together on appropriate mitigation measures, and the originally scheduled October event will be postponed to a later date.

Separately, following its Annual General Meeting, the Club announced results for the financial year ended 30 June 2026. Total wagering and lottery turnover reached a record HK$331.7 billion, up 3.6 per cent. Racing turnover rose 3.6 per cent to HK$143.3 billion and football betting also rose 3.6 per cent to a record HK$179 billion. The Club said it contributed HK$39.3 billion to the community, including HK$29.3 billion in betting duty and profits tax.

Tourist attendance at the city’s racecourses more than doubled to 401,259 during the 2025-26 season. The Club noted that significant investment in basketball betting and the Conghua facility, together with the continued challenge of illegal gambling, is expected to put pressure on operating surplus over the next few years.

zh.headline: 馬會延期從化馬場開跑 年度投注額創3317億元新高
zh.dek: 原定10月31日啟動常規賽馬因內地最新風險評估延期；馬會公布截至6月30日止財政年度業績，博彩及獎券投注總額按年升3.6%。
body: 香港賽馬會周三表示，原定10月31日於廣州從化馬場啟動常規賽馬賽事將延期。馬會指一直與相關內地部門緊密合作，並完成所有必要法定及程序要求，惟近日接獲最新風險評估。雙方經討論後同意繼續合作制訂適當緩解措施，原定10月活動因而延期至較後日子。
馬會於周年大會後公布截至2026年6月30日止財政年度業績。博彩及獎券投注總額創3317億元新高，按年升3.6%。賽馬投注額升3.6%至1433億元，足球博彩亦升3.6%至1790億元新高。馬會表示全年向社會貢獻393億元，包括293億元博彩稅及利得稅。
上馬季到訪沙田及跑馬地馬場的旅客達401259人次，按年增加105%。馬會指近年大力投資籃球博彩及從化馬場，加上非法賭博持續挑戰，預計未來數年營運盈餘將受壓。
